notes: run.py builds a repo per run from `fixture`, runs `prompt` with `claude -p`, then copies the PR files from ~/.ai/<repo-slug>/prs/ to outputs/prs/, writes outputs/git-state.txt, and deletes ~/.ai/<repo-slug>/. `pr_*` checks read all PR files joined. `pr_body_*` checks read them without the frontmatter. `state_*` checks read git-state.txt: `main-head <subject>`, then for each branch except main, `branch <name>`, then `subject <s>` for each commit in main..<name>, then `ancestors <refs>`. Regexes are case-insensitive unless a check sets `case`, except `reply_*` checks. `@name` in `patterns` or `input_regex` names a list in `pattern_sets`. `log_*` checks read branch-log.txt: `git log -p` of main..tags-in-list.

common_checks.text: Frontmatter has type, draft, base, and breaking
Body starts with an H1 title
Has no list with only one item
Has no hard line breaks in paragraphs or list items
Has no seeded slop words or long dashes

evals.name: small-fix
evals.prompt: /draft-pr I tested it on an emulator: a search for "milk" now finds the note "Milk and eggs".
evals.expected_output: A short fix PR: Context, Changes, Testing with the emulator check. No How to review, no High-impact changes, at most 1 review comment. The reply says that the skill set up git-spice.

patterns: ^branch fix/search-case\nsubject Ignore letter case in note search\nancestors
checks.text: fix/search-case has only its 1 commit
Sets up git-spice with trunk main
File name is the branch slug
Metadata: fix, not draft, base main, not breaking
Has no ticket field, because there is no ticket
Testing has the emulator check from the prompt
Has no review guide and no high-impact section
Has at most 1 review comment
Title has no code names
Reply has the 🧹 line
Reply has no manual check, split, or draft suggestion
